import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_75/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_75/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: Join Source4_75_0 and Source4_75_1 on 'school_name'
joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: Group by Source4_75_0.type and aggregate avg(size) and avg(budget)
# Note: size and budget come from df0, so after join they are columns in joined
grouped = joined.groupby("type", as_index=False).agg({
    "size": "mean",
    "budget": "mean"
})

# Rename columns to match target schema ['type', 'a', 'b']
grouped = grouped.rename(columns={"size": "a", "budget": "b"})

# The target columns 'a' and 'b' are floats, ensure dtype
grouped["a"] = grouped["a"].astype(float)
grouped["b"] = grouped["b"].astype(float)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_75/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_75/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_75/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'type' (string, leftmost key in target schema)
# Aggregate average reading_score and math_score as 'a' and 'b' respectively
result = joined.groupby("type").agg({
    "reading_score": "mean",
    "math_score": "mean"
}).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema
result.columns = ["type", "a", "b"]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_75/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
